title: Sight Reader
description: Practise reading music: name each note of a score as a cursor reaches it.

actions.title: Open a Score in Sight Reader
actions.description: Open one of Sight Reader's sample scores for the person at the page. The path is relative to the sample scores, such as simple/Frere Jacques.musicxml; the package's scores/index.json lists its own, and the host's score library, where there is one, lists more.
